cards.heading: Where there is love, there is discipline

blocks.text: Where there is love, there must be discipline - {{hb 12:6|Hebrews 12:6}}, {{re 3:19|Revelation 3:19}}. In this Mission, if a worker sins or does something their Pastor considers damaging to the progress or image of the church, they will receive prompt and proportionate correction. Depending on the severity of the offence, this can range from an open rebuke among fellow workers, to suspension from workers' meetings, to total dismissal from the workers' cadre.

During a period of discipline or suspension from workers' meetings, the worker must still attend all church services regularly, sitting wherever the Pastor directs - {{hb 12:5,hb 12:6,hb 12:7,hb 12:8|Hebrews 12:5-8}}; {{prv 3:11,prv 3:12|Proverbs 3:11-12}}.

cards.heading: The right to appeal, and the path to restoration

blocks.text: If a worker is not satisfied with the discipline imposed, they have the right to appeal - first to the Area Pastor, and ultimately to the General Overseer if still unsatisfied.

Genuine repentance can shorten a period of suspension; a worker who shows no genuine repentance will have their suspension automatically extended, and if repentance still doesn't follow, may be recommended to the General Overseer, through the Area Pastor, for dismissal from the workers' cadre.
